 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Philadelphia 76ers (8-2) and Chicago Bulls (1-7) will square off in the NBA tonight. Tipoff is set for 3:30 p.m. EST from United Center in Chicago, Ill. The game will be broadcast live on NBCS-PH.
 The 76ers are 9.5-point favorites on the spread (76ers -9.5), with the over/under set at 238.5 total points. The 76ers are -420 moneyline favorites to win outright, while the Bulls are listed as +330 underdogs to pull off the upset.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Let's get into my 76ers vs. Bulls predictions and NBA picks for Sunday, November 8.
 76ers vs Bulls Prediction
 76ers vs Bulls pick: Under 238.5 (-110) 
 My 76ers vs Bulls best bet is on the under total points, with the best price currently available at FanDuel. Make sure to find the best odds by checking our live NBA odds page.

 76ers vs Bulls Odds
 76ers vs Bulls Odds Table 76ers vs Bulls spread: 76ers -9.5 (-110), Bulls +9.5 (-110)
 76ers vs Bulls over/under: 238.5 (-106o / -114u)
 76ers vs Bulls moneyline: 76ers -420, Bulls +330
 76ers vs Bulls Pick, Betting Analysis
 These two teams are a combined 13-5 to the under this season.
 While Philadelphia 's defensive strength of schedule ranks near the bottom (28th per DunksAndThrees.com ), Chicago 's offense is even worse. The Bulls are loose and unstructured, and that doesn't help you against the Sixers with their individual talent and athleticism.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Bulls are the worst spot-up team in the league, and the Sixers have proven good enough at containing pick-and-roll actions, which is a Chicago strength.
 I project this total to land in the 220s—which may even lean optimistic given Chicago's No. 1 pace and Philly's raw firepower. This season, games with totals of 235.5 or higher have favored the over, hitting 38-22 (63.3% via KillerSports.com ).
 Finally, while the Sixers should put a big number on the Bulls, they take their time offensively, averaging the seventh-longest time per offensive possession. There's no reason for a team with these veterans to want to run up and down the floor with Chicago's kiddos.
 Pick: Under 238.5 (-110)
